explanation: A unique recorded phrase or complete file-scope match identifies existing work. Recency and task-name prefixes were not used.

context_boundary.instruction: Continue the selected existing work using its goal, state, constraints, acceptance criteria, and established approach. Set aside unrelated conventions in conversation history. Lessons are advisory, not overrides. Read references before editing. Missing or ambiguous approach selection requires review before claiming consistency.

approach.summary: Implement continuity behavior in shared deterministic Go packages, with CLI and MCP adapters using those packages.
rules: Keep canonical Markdown/YAML authoritative and the SQLite cache rebuildable
Choose approach inheritance through explicit parent and reuse relationships, never task-name prefixes
Preserve established rules and acceptance criteria when compacting context
Treat reference/literal checks as structural evidence; review semantic design consistency separately
Prevent task-switch contamination through explicit relationships or unambiguous file scopes and return a target context boundary; never select authority by recency.
Resolve incoming requests against recorded work identity before creating tasks; preserve existing completion state and distinguish continuation, independent work, and intentional replacement.
Use Go for the application and required validation; retain one check wrapper and historical evidence rather than obsolete experiment scripts.

context.detail_hint: Full rationale and evidence IDs: knodexa show <id> or knodexa_get_detail

task.title: MVP Core Engine
task.goal: Build deterministic local-first engineering memory core

accepted_constraints: Deterministic behavior: zero LLM calls in core engine
Evidence-driven verification for decisions and lessons
Preserve existing repository constraints and public APIs
Do not infer mandatory approach inheritance from task naming
Keep explicit approach rules in context even under budget pressure
Do not claim generated snapshots are installed skills or expose hidden reasoning
Never silently retain removed constraints or deleted nodes
Keep rollback behavior for malformed input and duplicate IDs

previous_decisions.summary: Retrieve work identity by recorded phrases and files, expose provenance and ambiguity, and restore a unique matched work without changing completion state or creating another task.
previous_decisions.title: Resolve incoming requests against existing work before task creation

previous_decisions.summary: Use explicit relationships first, then unique file coverage. Restore target agreements and emit a boundary excluding unrelated prior conventions; expose ambiguity without mixing rules.
previous_decisions.title: Scope implementation agreements to prevent task-switch contamination

previous_decisions.summary: Use inherited and explicitly reused approach contracts, reference code, skill paths, and reviewable structural checks.
previous_decisions.title: Restore explicit implementation agreements independently of task labels

previous_decisions.summary: Hash canonical content; parse and replace only edited records and remove deleted ownership within a transaction.
previous_decisions.title: Synchronize canonical records incrementally with transactional ownership

previous_failures.summary: A timed-out Codex subprocess aborted the repeated evaluation before all planned arms completed.
previous_failures.causal_details: The harness did not catch subprocess.TimeoutExpired from the shared live runner. This is an evaluation completion failure, not a measured context-contamination error. Timeout root cause in the agent/server remains unknown. Resolution: catch timeout as exit 124, persist partial trials, retain the invalid arm, and continue only outstanding planned arms.
